about: What Forever's game data doesn't have, for tools/gen_data.py: trainer costs and the skill each needs (training), vendors' patterns with their sellers and prices (patterns), vendor prices of materials in copper for one (vendorPrices), names of items the game data lacks (itemNames), and recipes the game files under gathering skills, listed here with crafting professions (extraRecipes). tools/update_data.py adds what leProfit records in game; you can also edit it by hand.
